descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S10 「两个模式下 Ask AI 失败：明确的报错，没有回答，新问题下面不留旧回答，打的问题保留」 Ask AI fails in both contexts: explicit error, no answer, no earlier answer left under the new question, the typed question is kept

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U6 Ask AI failed: an explicit error and no invented answer.（UAT EFS state 6；TFA-94745 state 6）
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection).（UAT EFS Expected Result；TFA-94745 AC 1；TFA-94745 AC 5）
  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content.（UAT EFS intro；UAT 3.4；TFA-94745 AC 2）
  • U13 Nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost in any failure state.（UAT EFS Expected Result；TFA-94745 AC 3）
  • U14 Every state works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android.（UAT EFS Expected Result；UAT 3.3；TFA-94745 AC 6）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Standard fixture (no labs on either chart); the harness answers the first ai/assist:askChart call of each sheet with a fixed reply and fails every later call

When Open Ask AI on the Hospital Pre-Round tab, ask 'What is the diagnosis?' (answered), then type the test question and ask (fails); then the same on the Nursing Home Encounter tab

Then After the failure the sheet says there is no answer and what to do; no answer text, no lab value, and the first answer is no longer shown as if it answered the second question; the second question is still in the box

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：From U6/U13: cp-answered mustContain the fixed reply (the mock works); cp-failed mustContain 'QA-EFS-10 which labs came back today?' — no chip holds it and the sheet does not echo the question, so only the textbox value can match (the textbox line carries a [ref=…] before its value, so the reviewer's 'textbox "…": value' string would never match) — plus one failure word and on …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S10 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/EFS.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：FAULT · 故障注入 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：dev。
